goal: Speed up initial sync and AssumeUTXO loading by avoiding redundant hash calculations on UTXO lookups
Trades a small memory increase per cached entry for faster table operations
agreement: Concept support because benchmarks justify the memory trade-off for faster execution (optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because IBD and reindex speedups are modest at 2% to 3%, though AssumeUTXO loading gains reach 11%
The speedup trades off increased cache memory usage and relies on compiler-specific standard library traits
